entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I hope you can help. I'm trying to return something, and I'm just so confused by the website. I don't know if I'm too late.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you please provide me with your name or order number so I can look up the purchase?
Yes, the name is Mark Peterson. I bought a helmet... I think it was maybe three or four weeks ago? I'm not sure.
Okay, Mr. Peterson, I see your account. I'm looking at an order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered on November 21st. That would make it 26 days ago. Is that the correct item?
Yes, that's the one! Oh, 26 days... is that bad? I just... the color wasn't what I expected when it arrived. And the box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out.
I understand. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference regarding the color?

It's just the color, really. It looked different online. And then I started to worry about its safety features... I just don't feel right about it. Can't you just help me? The whole process is overwhelming.

Of course, I can help you. Let me quickly check our return policy for you... one moment. Okay, yes, it looks like you are well within our 90-day return window. So we can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you.

You're most welcome. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on your account now. And since you're a VIP member with us, Mr. Peterson, I've also added a free shipping coupon to your account for your next order, in case you wanted to find a different helmet.
Wow, that's very kind of you. Thank you so much, Diana. You've made this very easy.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
